_description: Single source of truth for upstream versions baked into Dockerfile.alpine. Rewritten in lockstep with the Dockerfile by .github/workflows/check-versions.yml when nginx or the current alpine major.minor's patch level drifts. To migrate to a new alpine major.minor (e.g. 3.22 -> 3.23), edit `alpine` here directly — the workflow stays within whichever major.minor is currently pinned.
